title: Runner definition
description: How one test runner finds its tests, runs a selection of them, and leaves results: qualify evidence for qualification tests, JUnit XML for the rest. Data only; the CLI and the VS Code extension read these with one generic runner.

id.description: The runner ID that settings use, such as vitest.

framework.description: The test framework whose declarations this runner runs.

packageMarkers.description: Build files that pick this runner when several runners share a framework, such as pom.xml for Maven.

files.description: Globs of the files that may declare tests for this runner.

tools.description: What ${tool} becomes: the first entry whose file is in the package folder or a folder above it, or the first entry without a file. ${dir} is the path from the package folder to the folder holding the file.

select.description: How ${filter} selects tests by ID with the runner's own filter.

quote.description: Quote each term, the joined terms, or nothing, for the shell.

argument.description: The argument, from ${terms}, or from ${term} when repeat is true.

repeat.description: Write the argument once per term instead of once with every term.

qualify.description: Whether the framework has a qualify adapter, so qualification tests it runs write qualify evidence.

junit.description: How the runner writes JUnit XML, for tests without a qualify ID.

args.description: Arguments added to the command so that it writes JUnit XML to ${junitFile} (or ${junitDir} and ${junitName}).

env.description: Environment variables that make it write JUnit XML to ${junitFile}, or to ${junitDir} and ${junitName}.

file.description: Where the XML lands, relative to the package folder: the value of ${junitFile}, or a glob when the runner picks its own file names.

requires.description: What the project must install before the runner can write JUnit XML.
